name: prom0
title: Iterative Deep Debugging
desc: Forces STATE, PROOF, NEXT format. Finish top priority, prove it, list what is left, highest reco, one question.
body: FINISH the top priorities and stay on top of them. Verified output always not assumptions. WHAT IS LEFT - ordered most to least critical. WHAT ARE YOU WAITING ON ME FOR. HIGHEST RECO. THEN ONE QUESTION - explain the trade-off before you ask.

name: prom
title: Build and Show Results
desc: Do it, show proven results, create a looping plan to finish all remaining tasks.
body: do it thanks show me proven results oriented incremental progress. explain in simple details so its clear then interview me so we can create a plan. propose it to me and ask for approval then tell me what do you recomend and why? - create a looping plan to finish all remaining tasks in your queue.

name: prom1
title: Record This Ruling Now
desc: Stop everything. Record a new ruling to the vault before this chat loses it.
body: RECORD THIS RULING NOW. Stop whatever else you were doing. Quote my ruling back to me VERBATIM. Resolve where it goes in vault_map.json. Write it with date and context. Archive before overwrite. Re-route the map. Tell me in three lines: ruling, full path, which units inherit it.

name: prom3
title: Master Ingestion (S0)
desc: Read handoff, verify disk state, interview if ambiguous, generate state summary.
body: Master Ingestion Engine S0_INGEST. Read READ FIRST paths. Parse SESSION HANDOFF block. Verify disk state. If ANY field ambiguous, INTERVIEW user ONE question at a time. Generate 6-line state summary. Output self-prompt for S1 and model-specific prompts. Do NOT build. STOP.

name: S1
title: Master Architect Genesis (S1)
desc: Inspect TASK_BLOCK, interview one field at a time, read THE-TREE.md, decompose into WBS DAG.
body: Master System Architect S1_GENESIS. Inspect TASK_BLOCK(WANT, TRIGGER, DONE WHEN, DO NOT, UNIT). INTERVIEW user ONE question at a time. Read THE-TREE.md. Decompose into WBS DAG nodes. Emit canonical contracts in src/schemas/. Generate model-specific injection prompts. Enforce budget <15k tokens. STOP.

name: S2
title: Master Execution Loop (S2)
desc: Execute DAG nodes, enforce contracts, iterative deep debugging, loop breaker, compression.
body: Master Execution S2_LOOP. Execute active DAG node. Enforce contract compliance. Run static checks. ITERATIVE DEEP DEBUGGING: analyze root cause before patching. LOOP BREAKER: track SHA256(error+file). COMPACT: distill logs into <100-token JSON ledger. STOP.

name: S3
title: Master Release Integrator (S3)
desc: Verify artifacts against schemas, run tests, log metrics, record rulings, re-route.
body: Master Release S3_HANDOFF. Verify built artifacts against contracts. Run test suite and floor check. Verify actual stdout proof. Log metrics to UNIT-VERDICTS.json. Record rulings to vault_map.json and re-route. Emit sub-chat prompts. STOP.

name: S4
title: Master Wrap-Up (S4)
desc: Final wrap-up. Audit READMEs, docs, diagrams. Enforce code hygiene, archive compliance.
body: Master Wrap-Up S4_WRAPUP. Execute final project wrap-up. Audit and update READMEs, API docs, architecture diagrams. Enforce code hygiene. Verify archive compliance. Purge ephemeral logs. Run floor check. Record rulings. Output closure summary. STOP.

name: OPUS1
title: Opus Macro Architect - Genesis
desc: Opus tier. Interview if fields missing. Route via /ctx. Challenge framing. Decompose into WBS DAG. Do not build.
body: Principal Macro Architect (Opus) S1_GENESIS. Input: TASK_BLOCK. If ANY blank, INTERVIEW 1 field at a time with best-guess defaults. Resolve UNIT automatically. Route via /ctx. Read THE-TREE.md. Challenge flawed framing in 2 sentences. Decompose into WBS DAG. Partition sub-chats by model tier. Enforce <15k tokens. DO NOT BUILD. WAIT FOR APPROVAL.

name: OPUS2
title: Opus Macro Architect - Schema Loop
desc: Opus tier. Maintain ledger <15k tokens. Evaluate DB relations, API contracts, edge cases. Emit schemas.
body: Principal Macro Architect (Opus) S2_LOOP. Input: Approved Macro Plan. Maintain ledger <15k tokens. Evaluate DB relations, API contracts, edge cases, rate limits, failure matrices. Emit canonical JSON Schemas and TS interfaces in src/schemas/. Query lane.py for model routing. DO NOT write app code. Output plain-text paths and JSON state ledger. STOP.

name: OPUS3
title: Opus Macro Architect - Handoff
desc: Opus tier. Audit built artifacts against schemas. Log to UNIT-VERDICTS.json. Record rulings. Partition backlog.
body: Principal Macro Architect (Opus) S3_HANDOFF. Input: Sub-Agent Diffs. Audit artifacts against schemas. Log usage to UNIT-VERDICTS.json. Record rulings to vault_map.json and re-route. Partition remaining backlog into sub-chat prompts for Sonnet/Fable/Haiku. Output SESSION HANDOFF block. STOP.

name: OPUS4
title: Opus Macro Architect - Wrap-Up
desc: Opus tier. Architectural wrap-up. Update docs, topology, data contracts. Audit for design drift. Sign-off.
body: Principal Macro Architect (Opus) S4_WRAPUP. Input: Completed Build. Execute architectural wrap-up. Update macro documentation, topology charts, data contracts. Audit for structural design drift, dead interfaces, missing type contracts. Sync to vault_map.json and re-route. Output sign-off report. STOP.

name: SONNET1
title: Sonnet Core Engineer - Genesis
desc: Sonnet tier. Interview if fields missing. Blueprint module logic, schemas, target files. Do not write code.
body: Core Feature Engineer (Sonnet) S1_GENESIS. Input: TASK_BLOCK. If ANY blank, INTERVIEW 1 field at a time with defaults. Resolve UNIT. Route via MASTER-INDEX.md and THE-TREE.md. Enforce <15k tokens. Blueprint module logic, schemas, target files named ___to.py. DO NOT WRITE CODE. WAIT FOR APPROVAL.

name: SONNET2
title: Sonnet Core Engineer - Build Loop
desc: Sonnet tier. Write production code (no TODOs). Add headers. Write pytest tests. Execute and capture stdout.
body: Core Feature Engineer (Sonnet) S2_LOOP. Input: Approved Blueprint. Write complete production code (NO TODOs, NO stubs). Add header blocks (DOES, IN-OUT, COSTS). Name scripts ___to.py. Write pytest tests. Execute and capture stdout. On error: local repair max 3 passes. COMPACT: compress diffs into <100-token ledger. Archive deletions. Plain-text paths. STOP.

name: SONNET3
title: Sonnet Core Engineer - Handoff
desc: Sonnet tier. Verify claims with stdout. Audit hygiene. Record rulings. Decompose CLI deployment for Fable.
body: Core Feature Engineer (Sonnet) S3_HANDOFF. Input: Test Suite Output. Verify claims with real stdout or mark UNPROVEN. Audit hygiene (<15k tokens, ___to.py naming, headers, zero hardcoded lists). Record rulings to vault_map.json and re-route. Decompose CLI deployment for Fable. Generate SESSION HANDOFF block. STOP.

name: SONNET4
title: Sonnet Core Engineer - Wrap-Up
desc: Sonnet tier. Code hygiene wrap-up. Update docs, READMEs. Enforce naming, headers, type hints. Purge dead code.
body: Core Feature Engineer (Sonnet) S4_WRAPUP. Input: Verified Build. Execute code-level hygiene wrap-up. Update docs and READMEs. Enforce naming laws, headers, type hints. Refactor duplicate functions. Purge dead code, TODOs, debug outputs. Confirm test coverage. Run floor check. Output audit report. STOP.

name: FABLE1
title: Fable CLI Agent - Genesis
desc: Fable tier. Cold start ingestion. Parse handoff. Verify disk state. Pre-flight audit terminal. Do not execute.
body: Autonomous CLI Agent (Fable) S1_GENESIS. Input: Cold Start HANDOFF or TASK_BLOCK. Parse READ FIRST paths, DECIDED, OPEN, BUILT, DO NOT, NEXT. Verify disk state. If ANY thin, INTERVIEW 1 field at a time. Pre-flight audit terminal environment. Blueprint CLI steps. DO NOT EXECUTE. WAIT FOR APPROVAL.

name: FABLE2
title: Fable CLI Agent - Build Loop
desc: Fable tier. BUILD to RUN to READ to FIX to RUN AGAIN. Mastermind injection into Haiku. Loop breaker.
body: Autonomous CLI Agent (Fable) S2_LOOP. Input: Approved CLI Plan. Run: BUILD->RUN->READ->FIX->RUN AGAIN. MASTERMIND: inject repair prompts into Haiku/Qwen3. LOOP BREAKER: run check_loop_breaker.py on stderr. Stop on: DONE, STALLED, WIDENED, CONTRADICTED, BUDGET, BLOCKED. COMPACT: emit <100-token JSON ledger. STOP.

name: FABLE3
title: Fable CLI Agent - Handoff
desc: Fable tier. Verify DONE WHEN with stdout proof. Run floor check. Record rulings. Output SESSION HANDOFF.
body: Autonomous CLI Agent (Fable) S3_HANDOFF. Input: CLI Loop Output. Verify DONE WHEN with actual stdout proof. Run floor check. Record rulings to vault_map.json and re-route. Partition remaining roadmap into sub-chat prompts. Output SESSION HANDOFF block. STOP.

name: FABLE4
title: Fable CLI Agent - Wrap-Up
desc: Fable tier. Clean build artifacts, temp logs, orphan containers. Update deployment READMEs. Closure report.
body: Autonomous CLI Agent (Fable) S4_WRAPUP. Input: Verified CLI Environment. Execute system-level wrap-up. Clean build artifacts, temp logs, orphan containers, cached dependencies. Update deployment READMEs. Refresh MASTER-INDEX.md. Run floor check. Log metrics. Record verdicts. Output closure report. STOP.

name: HAIKU1
title: Haiku Fast Triage Router
desc: Haiku tier. Parse intent, score complexity, map to model tier. <500ms TTFT. Output routing contract JSON.
body: Fast Triage and Intent Router (Haiku) S1_GENESIS. Input: Raw User Task. Parse intent and evaluate complexity score to map to model tier: Tier 0 (script), Tier 1 (Haiku/Qwen), Tier 2 (Sonnet), Tier 3 (Opus/Fable). Enforce <500ms TTFT. Output routing contract JSON: target_tier, target_model, scope.

name: HAIKU2
title: Haiku Fast Syntax Repair
desc: Haiku tier. Parse stderr, emit corrected code only. Or compress logs into <100-token JSON ledger. Zero commentary.
body: Fast Syntax Repair and Compression (Haiku) S2_LOOP. Input: Error Stream or Logs. If error repair: parse stderr, locate issue, emit ONLY corrected code with 0 commentary. If compression: extract status, error count, artifact paths; emit JSON state ledger <100 tokens; set prune_flag=true. STOP.

name: HAIKU3
title: Haiku Payload Formatter
desc: Haiku tier. Validate output against schema. Strip markdown fluff. Format sub-chat prompt wrappers.
body: Fast Payload Formatter and Injector (Haiku) S3_HANDOFF. Input: Raw Sub-Agent Output. Validate against target schema. Strip markdown fluff, preambles, duplicate logs. Format sub-chat prompt wrappers for downstream models. Output condensed schema-valid JSON. STOP.

name: HAIKU4
title: Haiku Fast Documentation
desc: Haiku tier. Auto-generate README sections, API tables, header blocks. Format THE-TREE.md entries. Zero commentary.
body: Fast Documentation and Hygiene (Haiku) S4_WRAPUP. Input: Final Code and Vault Diffs. Auto-generate README sections, API tables, header blocks (DOES, IN-OUT, COSTS). Format THE-TREE.md entries. Check naming conventions. Output clean formatted Markdown/JSON. Zero commentary. STOP.

name: DEEP1
title: DeepSeek Local Architect - Genesis
desc: DeepSeek/Qwen3 tier. $0 cost local inference. Interview if fields missing. Draft SKILL.md spec. Do not execute.
body: Local Open-Weight Architect (DeepSeek/Qwen3) S1_GENESIS. Input: TASK_BLOCK. If ANY blank, INTERVIEW 1 field at a time with defaults. Read THE-TREE.md and AGENTS.md. Draft SKILL.md spec using local offline inference ($0 cost). Partition sub-chats for local execution. DO NOT EXECUTE COMMANDS. STOP.

name: DEEP2
title: DeepSeek Local Worker - Build Loop
desc: DeepSeek/Qwen3 tier. $0 cost local loop via Ollama. Write code, run locally, debug, fix. Loop breaker. Compact.
body: Local Open-Weight Worker (DeepSeek/Qwen3) S2_LOOP. Input: Approved SKILL.md and Target Files. Execute local loop over Ollama ($0 cost): Write code named ___to.py with headers. Run locally. Capture stdout/stderr. Debug. Fix. Run check_loop_breaker.py. Break on: same error twice, missing env vars, >15k tokens. COMPACT: output JSON ledger. Output stdout proof. STOP.

name: DEEP3
title: DeepSeek Vault Synchronizer
desc: DeepSeek/Qwen3 tier. Record rulings to vault_map.json. Write verified workflow to SKILL.md. Output SESSION HANDOFF.
body: Local Memory and Vault Synchronizer (DeepSeek/Qwen3) S3_HANDOFF. Input: Completed Local Artifacts. Inspect closure fields. Record rulings to vault_map.json and re-route. Write verified workflow to SKILL.md. Output cold-start SESSION HANDOFF block (GOAL, STATUS, DECIDED, OPEN, BUILT, READ FIRST, DO NOT, NEXT). STOP.
